title: Logistic Regression
body:
[[Sigmoid]]

Regression for a categorical response. [[Linear Regression]] fits a number by
minimising squared error in closed form; this fits a probability by squashing a linear score
through a [[Sigmoid]] and minimising [[Log Loss]], which has no closed form and needs
[[Gradient Descent]]. What it is really fitting is a [[Bernoulli Distribution]] whose $p$ depends
on the input.
